links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of candidate LLM tools versus clinicians and general LLM on same questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o outperformed CapyEngine and clinicians at top 10 and top 5 (all P<.03); clinicians beat CapyEngine at top 5 (OR 0.26, P=.02); top 1 no significant differences.
links.quote: Across diagnostic accuracy thresholds, ChatGPT-4o consistently outperformed both CapyEngine and clinicians in broader rankings (top 10 and top 5 benchmarks; all P<.03).

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific DSM-5-TR-based retrieval architecture for diagnostic LLM

screen.reason: The study evaluates the usability and diagnostic accuracy of an LLM-based diagnostic co-pilot (CapyEngine) compared to ChatGPT-4o and clinicians using standardized board exam case scenarios.
